reviews.title: MUY MAL SERVICIO
reviews.text: Lo único rescatable es que es un hotel muy grande y remodelaron un poco las habitaciones y digo un poco por que solo cambiaron el mobiliario. De ahí en fuera sigue siendo el mismo piso etc. / La comida del buffet es muy mala. Pocas opciones y todo sin sabor.   Anteriormente si te llevaban la comida del Snack bar hasta tu camastro en el área de alberca, ahora ya ni eso! Me pareció muy descortés eso, es lo menos que uno puede esperar de un lugar que no es nada barato. Snack bar lo abren hasta las 12 pm y la comida es muy mala, hamburguesas secas Hot Dog, alitas grasosas, etc. En el área de la alberca hay muy pocos meseros que son los que llevan las bebidas, se tardan muchísimo por lo mismo de que son pocos no abarcan todo. En en beach club nos ofrecieron un paquete para rentar una Balinesa frente al mar y nos dieron una botella de Moët y mariscos, los mariscos estaban malísimos de sabor. Y la atención del beach club Kanna fue PÉSIMA, el mesero fue muy desatento, si no le hablábamos no venía a ver si se nos ofrecía algo, estábamos batallando para cerrar las cortinas de la balinesa y nos vio y se pasó de largo en vez de ayudar.  Otro detalle enorme No me quisieron emitir mi factura fiscal porque la reserva estaba a mi nombre y yo la necesitaba a nombre de mi esposo porque pagamos con su tarjeta fiscal. Una tontería, jamás me habían echo algo así en otro lugar… a ver ahora como justifico esos 30 mil pesos. Porque ellos dicen que NO se puede. Muy mal trato para haber pagado $4,100!!!! Un robo, estafa total. En fin muy mal servicio, hay mejores opciones por ese precio. Lástima de hotel tan grande tiene mucho potencial pero en vez de mejorar empeoraron
reviews.author: Cuevas

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text:
Great location, nice modern rooms, and concierge Eduardo Mena was outstanding -he went above and beyond, often resolving issues before they even arose. / We stayed at the hotel both before and right after the renovation. Unfortunately, aside from the room updates, nothing else seems to have changed.

The buffet had very limited food options, and there were extremely long lines -we even had to wait for something as simple as boiled eggs.

During lunch, staff were painting areas nearby, and the smell of paint spread throughout the entire buffet, which was quite unpleasant.

Room service was inconsistent -after calling, it took about three hours for them to show up. By that time it was already late at night, and we had put up the “Do Not Disturb” sign, which was ignored.

Housekeeping was below expectations. We had to document issues with photos, including hair in cups, dirty tissues with debris, and cigarette packaging, and send them to the concierge.

Waiting times are a serious issue at this hotel -waiting an hour for a burger by the pool seems to be considered normal. In general, waiting is part of the experience here.

The gym is outdated -while it has basic equipment, everything is quite worn out and could definitely use an upgrade

reviews.title: Underwhelming, boring and scammy
reviews.text:
Nothing specific to the property. Cancun’s beaches by themselves are beautiful. / The room we stayed in was average with poor air conditioning. 
This property needs to look up the meaning of the word “hospitality”. 
The concierge and guest services teams are slow, clueless, unhelpful and incompetent. 
They call themselves “all inclusive” but constantly try to get you to spend your hard earned $$$ at every conceivable opportunity. For example there are restaurants in the hotel that you need to pay extra for??? Oh and you need to make reservations for the majority of the restaurants. Pool beds and cabanas are up for rental even though there aren’t enough “free” ones to accommodate all guests. Seriously? If you’re going to up-charge your guests at every opportunity at least have the decency to make it abundantly clear that your property isn’t exactly all inclusive in the true sense of the word. 
The property is sleepy at night and the entertainment is forgettable. 
Spend a little more money to stay at a brand name resort like Hyatt because you actually get an all inclusive experience. It’s a real shame because the beach itself is so beautiful.

reviews.title: Will never go back
reviews.text:
Room had a great view, buffet option was good and some decent staff people. / Wow where do I begin?
Why is this hotel so popular (I am still in disbelief)?
We stayed 8 days / 7 nights with family concierge service.
We were told we cannot make any restaurant reservation until you arrive. As soon as we got there - they said family concierge will help restaurant reservation. And yet we were unable to get table at most decent restaurants as they are all booked. Steak one - only adults. The Kanna beach club ( the great photos of cabanas you see onlime)  - is only if you pay $250 extra / day / cabana. Snd also extra for food. Even with all inclusive resort.  Also by the pool - all this pretty cabanas pictures u see facing the ocean .. Only if u pay $250 extra/ day . Most of these cabanas were empty as no one wanted to pay. We had no lounge chairs most days .

The beach or swimming pool lounge chairs - you will be lucky if you get one - only to find out  you have go wake up 5.30am- 6am  and go down n save a spot . Or leave towel. So one morning I was up by 6 n saved a spot by poll. But was told not to leave your spot??? ( So I should just sit there without going back to room for shower or get breakfast??

Anyways I left my kids swim jackets on the chairs n went to my room. Came back with my family after breakfast-    Stuff was all gone.  Took us hours to locate our stuff. Most days we put towels on ground / beach without any chairs.   Most days we ordered  in our room with  limited menu  ( horrible ) inspite of restaurants as they  have no tables available at Capella or Cielo or lemon fish or steak
Only time given go us for 5.30pm reservation which we did couple of times but couldn’t eat this early dinner anymore.  Also you are not allowed to take food or order     In your room from any of the restaurants.

The buffet for breakfast was a joke too . Omelette station - if you really want to stand 45 min :) Only time to get decent breakfast if u wake up again 6.
